title: EMBA 英文面谈
subtitle_en: I graduated from business school and now run a company.
goal_text: 在 EMBA 英文面谈里说清背景、为什么现在读、读完要做什么。
brief_cn: 面谈官不会只听你说的经历，他会连着问“为什么是现在”“读完打算做什么”“能给个例子吗”。这一课把这些追问的答法练成短句，四句话站住一场面试。

vocab.example_en: I graduated from business school in 2015.
I now run a trading company.
I want to apply for this EMBA program.
The main reason is that my company is growing fast.
After the program, I plan to expand our business.
I plan to add an online sales team.
Let me give you an example.

briefing.accept_notes: graduated 重音在第一音节，-ed 读 /ɪd/，别读成 /ed/。

briefing.ref_text: I now run a trading company.
briefing.translation_cn: 我现在经营一家贸易公司。
briefing.accept_notes: run a company 连读，trading 重音在前。

briefing.cn_prompt: 听一遍，用自己的话说出他的背景和报考原因。
briefing.ref_text: I graduated from business school. I now run a company. I am applying because my company is growing.
briefing.translation_cn: 我从商学院毕业，现在经营一家公司。因为公司正在发展，我正在申请。
briefing.reference_answer: I graduated from business school, I now run a company, and I am applying because it is growing.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出毕业、经营公司和报考原因三点即算通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：解释你为什么现在来读。
briefing.ref_text: 我申请这个项目是因为公司正在发展。
briefing.reference_answer: I am applying for this program because my company is growing.
briefing.accept_notes: applying for this program + because 接一个理由即通过。

briefing.cn_prompt: 说成英文：说完毕业后的打算。
briefing.ref_text: 毕业后，我计划扩展业务。
briefing.reference_answer: After the program, I plan to expand our business.
briefing.accept_notes: After the program 开头，plan to 后面接一件具体的事。

briefing.cn_prompt: 用 example 起头，说自己要举一个工作中的例子。
briefing.reference_answer: Let me give you an example.
briefing.accept_notes: 说出 Let me give you an example 即算通过，后面接什么由他发挥。

mission.persona_cn: EMBA 招生官，会顺着你的回答往下追问
mission.user_role_cn: 来参加英文面谈的企业管理者
mission.context_cn: 招生官手上已有你的材料，所以他不想听背景复述，他要听你为什么现在来、读完做什么、能不能举一个真实例子。回答越具体，追问越早结束。
mission.opening_a: Welcome. Please tell me about your education and work.
mission.opening_a_cn: 欢迎。请介绍一下你的教育和工作经历。

exchanges.a: Welcome. Please tell me about your education and work.
exchanges.b: I graduated from business school and now run a trading company.
exchanges.a_cn: 欢迎。请介绍一下你的教育和工作经历。
exchanges.b_cn: 我从商学院毕业，现在经营一家贸易公司。

exchanges.b: I'm applying now because my company is growing.
exchanges.b_cn: 我现在申请，因为公司正在发展。

exchanges.a: What do you want to learn?
exchanges.b: I want to learn how to run a bigger team.
exchanges.b_cn: 我想学会怎么带更大的团队。

exchanges.a: What will you do after the program?
exchanges.b: After the program, I plan to expand our business.
exchanges.a_cn: 项目结束后你会做什么？
exchanges.b_cn: 项目结束后，我计划扩展我们的业务。

exchanges.b: I plan to add an online sales team.
exchanges.a_cn: 你能说得更具体一些吗？
exchanges.b_cn: 我计划增加一个线上销售团队。

exchanges.a: Can you give an example from your work?
exchanges.b: Let me give you an example. I led a small team to win a big client.
exchanges.a_cn: 能举一个你工作中的例子吗？
exchanges.b_cn: 我举个例子：我带一个小团队拿下过一个大客户。

exchanges.b: It took four months and two trips.

tasks.desc_cn: 介绍教育和工作背景（一句就够）
tasks.hint_en: I graduated from business school and now run a trading company.
tasks.hint_cn: 学历 + 现在做什么，一句说完。

tasks.desc_cn: 说清为什么是现在来读，而不是三年前
tasks.hint_en: I'm applying now because my company is growing.
tasks.hint_cn: because 后面一定给一个业务事实。

tasks.hint_en: After the program, I plan to expand our business.
tasks.hint_cn: plan to 后面接具体动作，别说 improve myself。

tasks.hint_en: I led a small team to win a big client.
tasks.hint_cn: 举例要有数字：时间、人数、结果。
